title: Free AI Tools Directory
tagline: Real free tiers, not trials that expire tomorrow

cards.name: ChatGPT
cards.limits: Message caps on the standard model that reset over time; advanced models reserved for paid plans
cards.notes: The easiest starting point if you have never used an AI chat before.

cards.name: Claude
cards.limits: Daily message cap that varies with demand; longer chats soak up the cap faster
cards.notes: Known for long, careful answers and a big context window.

cards.name: Google Gemini
cards.limits: Standard model free with a generous cap; advanced models are paid
cards.notes: Handy if you already live in Gmail and Google Docs.

cards.name: Microsoft Copilot
cards.limits: Free daily chat; image generation has slower speeds on the free tier
cards.notes: Works in Edge and Windows without an extra account beyond a Microsoft login.

cards.name: Mistral Le Chat
cards.limits: Rate limits during busy periods; some flagship models are paid only

cards.name: HuggingChat
cards.limits: Open-source models free to chat with; usage caps at peak times
cards.notes: Good way to try open-weight models with zero setup.

cards.name: DeepSeek
cards.limits: Free chat and code help; heavy reasoning may queue during peak hours
cards.notes: Strong at math and code for a free service.

cards.name: GitHub Copilot
cards.limits: Monthly cap on completions and chats for free accounts; premium models are paid
cards.notes: Sign in with your GitHub account; the free tier moved into VS Code and github.com.

cards.name: Google AI Studio
cards.limits: Daily request quotas per model for API experiments; free tier data may be used to improve models
cards.notes: The friendliest way to experiment with Gemini as a developer.

cards.name: Qwen Coding Portal
cards.limits: Free access with rate limits; coding models queue at busy times
cards.notes: Popular free option for AI-assisted coding sessions.

cards.name: Microsoft Designer
cards.limits: Daily image credits with slower boosts on the free plan

cards.name: Canva
cards.limits: Core editor free; Pro stock assets and AI credits are clearly marked paid
cards.notes: The free plan is genuinely usable if you avoid Pro-marked items.

cards.name: Ollama
cards.limits: Runs on your own machine; model size limited by your RAM and disk
cards.notes: One command installs a local model runner; nothing leaves your computer.

cards.name: LM Studio
cards.limits: Desktop app testing free for individuals; needs roughly 8 GB RAM or more
cards.notes: Point-and-click local models, no terminal comfort required.

cards.name: Jan
cards.limits: Runs local models on your hardware; speed depends on your CPU and RAM
cards.notes: Open-source desktop app with an interface like a chat app.

cards.name: Google Colab
cards.limits: Free notebooks share GPUs with time and idle limits; long sessions eventually disconnect
cards.notes: Run Python automations without installing anything.

cards.name: GitHub Pages
cards.limits: Public repos only on free accounts; published content must be non-personal, non-commercial per GitHub's terms
cards.notes: Hosting for sites exactly like the one this template builds.
